about: Lab 07's labels: the one line each fixture of the engine's link-safety test is shown by, written by us, keyed by the sha256 of the fixture's exact text (scripts/vendor-link-safety.mjs refuses a fixture with no label and a label with no fixture). A poisoned URL is never printed on the page as it is; a line of code is printed as it is unless the publisher's screen refuses it, and only those carry a label here.
